description: This file defines the JSON schema for the MaintenanceManager plugin's API, detailing methods, events, and data structures used to control and monitor maintenance activities on set-top devices.

methods.name: getMaintenanceActivityStatus
methods.description: Retrieves detailed status information about ongoing maintenance activities, including maintenance state, last completion time, and whether reboot is pending.

methods.name: getMaintenanceStartTime
methods.description: Provides the scheduled start time for upcoming maintenance activities.

methods.name: setMaintenanceMode
methods.description: Configures the maintenance mode and software update opt-out mode, affecting how updates are handled during maintenance window.

methods.name: startMaintenance
methods.description: Initiates maintenance activities and triggers status change events.

methods.name: stopMaintenance
methods.description: Stops ongoing maintenance activities and triggers status change events.

methods.name: getMaintenanceMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current maintenance mode and opt-out settings stored persistently.
